Bipartisan Senate efforts, working closely w/ law enforcement and #2A advocates, produced just that: the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. This bill overwhelmingly focuses on community mental health initiatives & school safety, with $300M for the STOP School Violence Act. 2/4

There is also funding states can apply for to implement veteran/mental health/drug courts or other crisis intervention services that ensure police can help individuals who pose a threat to themselves or to others while respecting due process and rights enshrined under #2A. 3/4

One bill will not solve broader issues of violence/mental health; that requires communities coming together to address social alienation, lack of purpose, familial erosion, etc. But this bill is a significant step in the right direction that will save lives. I voted yes. 4/4
